summary: Frontend-only regression completed on public preview URL with mobile-first focus. Globe scroll animation behavior validated via real wheel/tap interactions at 390x844 and 320x740, plus reduced-motion and horizontal-drag checks. No blocking UI/integration regressions found.
action_items: Optional hardening: guard followGlobeScroll(current, ...) against non-finite current values to prevent NaN propagation in extreme edge cases.
Optional perf follow-up: investigate recurring WebGL 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' warning on Chromium preview (non-blocking in this run).
critical_code_review_comments: Requested scope respected in codebase: globe runtime behavior is isolated to src/components/globe.tsx + src/globe-motion.ts; no hero/layout copy changes observed.
globeScrollPose() satisfied tested invariants (pose0 baseline, deterministic output, progress clamping, zoom bounds, reduced-motion suppression).
followGlobeScroll() clamps dt/target and behaves frame-rate-independently in tests, but does not sanitize a non-finite current input (potential robustness gap, not user-visible in this run).
seed_data_creation: None (no waitlist submission performed in this run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use real wheel/touch gestures for scroll validation; programmatic scrollTo({top}) on landing-scroll was unreliable in automation though user-facing scroll worked via Explore and wheel. Artifacts include top/checkpoint/deep/return screenshots for both 390x844 and 320x740 and reduced-motion run.
rca_of_issue: No blocking defect reproduced for requested globe animation. Exploratory edge-case review found potential NaN propagation only if followGlobeScroll receives non-finite current input; not triggered through normal UI flow.
